mapper.select: select count(text_uid) from (select text_uid from blog_text limit 140) as temp;

select b.text_uid as 'textUid', u.uid as 'userUid', b.text_title as 'title', u.nickname as 'userNickName', b.build_time as 'buildTime' from blog_text as b, user as u where u.uid = b.user_uid limit #{from},7;

select b.text_title as 'title', b.text as 'text', b.build_time as 'buildTime', b.update_time as 'updateTime', u.nickname as 'userNickName' from blog_text as b, user as u where b.text_uid = #{id} and b.user_uid = u.uid;
mapper.insert: insert into blog_text values ( #{textUid} , #{userUid} , #{text} , #{title} , now() , now())
